_about: 3-30 (wave 4a, R4 round 1; no route before): the fire diamond for the knight and the crates, the gutter mouth to hand the fire back, then two portals for the blue key. Five shots, three of
them fireballs and two portals (the door asks for 2 portals; golden score 4); no knight ever sights him (no exclamation and no shot in the run) and no achievement is unlocked.
Knight A (minion_spawn_2193) takes the yellow key at its spawn (408, 238), walks to wayB0 (x 455.2) by tick 47 and holds there facing right for 5000 ms, until 360: all of it is done behind it.
Right 1-139: the fire diamond (242, 238) is his on 64 (from then every tap is a fireball) and he stops at x 395.4, 60 units behind the holding knight. Tap 150 at (455, 240) (a fireball along
the floor at 2.1 u a tick; the tap's y may be 232 to 246) burns the knight, which is gone on 174 with the key at (455.2, 236.3). Right 175-235: the key is his on 190 (26 units); the floor's flat
top ends at x 502.4 and a chamfer takes it to its end face at 512, so at about x 509 he walks off (tick ~221), falls 46 units onto crate_2356 (top y 299.6, x 517-575), lands on 232 and walks on
to x 539.7. The two crates fill the chute in front of both keyholes, so the fire takes them one at a time from on top: tap 246 at (539.7, 340) shoots straight down at the crate under him
(burning 252, gone 315: BURN_TIME 1000 ms), he drops 57 units onto crate_2355 (top y 357.1) and tap 335 at (539.7, 385) does the same (burning 341, gone 404). He stands on a burning crate for 63
ticks each time and is not hurt (a flame kills him, a burning crate only fades). He is on the chute's floor (y 414) on 416 and the yellow key, 19 units from keyhole_ent_2353 (558, 394), went into
it on 413; door_locked_ent_2052 is gone on 506. Left 421-451 to x 465.3 along the floor of the nook under the level's floor: the gutter mouth (node (478, 316), trigger 10 x 76 at offset (0, 46):
x 473-483, y 324-400) takes the diamond trailing him as it passes, on 452 (fire_diamond_drained), and the portals work again; he stands 6 ticks so the diamond has surely passed, and right 458-476 to
x 510.9, the nook's mouth. The blue key lies on the ledge (578-768, top y 254) at (734.9, 238), whose underside and the two doors close the chute's top, and the only ray that reaches the air over it
from below passes the ledge's left corner. The camera on the chute's floor shows y 256 to 512, so a drag (tick 480 to 494, 'shot': false: the finger down 50 units from (420, 300) to (420, 350))
pans the view up 100 (camera.json drag: twice the finger's move; the follow waits 4 s unless he walks or goes through a portal) to y 156-412, which holds both the target and him. Tap 498 at
(605, 180) (the ray from (510.9, 396.4) crosses y 254 at x 573, 5 units left of the ledge's face; the target may be x 584 to 624, y 158 to 210) opens a portal there on 566 after a 67-tick flight,
and tap 572 at (510.9, 399) on the player takes him to it on 574: he falls onto the ledge (586) and walks right (590-636) to the blue key, taken on 634 (26 units). Left 637-724 along the ledge:
off its left end on ~695, down the chute along the blue door's face (x 579) to the floor on 713, and the key goes into keyhole_2053 (530, 394) on 714 (25.5 units; the walk on to x 523 would carry it
in anyway); door_locked_2352 is gone on 807. Right 748-881: he waits at the door's face (x 570.7) from 769, walks through on 807, off the platform's end (x 640, ~836) onto the block (704, 496)
on 847 and into the exit door (704, 432; its trigger at y 469): won on tick 860. The route stands on no sliding or creeping contact: the crate shots need no aim (straight down from on top of
the crate) and the drain is a 10-unit slot the diamond must pass, with a pause after it. Every tap and every walk edge was moved by 1 to 3 ticks and wins (the first walk's start cannot move
earlier; the key walks only change the win tick by the same ticks). Leans on G10 (the walk 2.4 u a tick, the capsule on a chamfer), G4 (the shot's flight), R23 (the tap-time ray, and a diamond
carrier's tap a fireball), G1a (the holding knight's cone: behind it he is unseen), fire (steps 114 and 134), the gutter (Diamonds), the camera drag (step 138) and the keys (Keys).
